$comment: Canonical list of files and globs that Pull-SDLC.ai.ps1 will pull into a consumer project. Patterns are matched against the upstream tree via git ls-tree -r <ref>. Globs use wildmatch semantics (* matches a single path segment, ** matches any number of segments). Paths in .github/instructions/project.instructions.md (or anything listed under script:AlwaysLocalPaths) are NEVER overwritten regardless of whether they appear in this manifest.
